objective: Understand how the intended user currently handles the relevant task.
target_group: People with recent experience of the task.
inclusion_criteria: Has completed the task within the past six months.
recruitment_channel: To be selected and documented before recruitment.
sampling_rationale: Exploratory qualitative discovery; not a population estimate.
accessibility_and_language: Ask participants about preferred language and access needs.
storage_and_access_plan: Store de-identified notes in the protected project workspace; consent records remain outside Git.
retention_and_deletion_plan: Define a retention date and delete identifiable material when no longer needed or when withdrawal requires it.
limitations: Template only; no participants have been recruited or interviewed.
